findings: BLOCKER - PH-313 pool reversal correction is still self-contradictory: the new §3.1 text says '包含 reverses_posting IS NULL 的原 posting，并排除其 reverses_posting 指向的负值冲销行（成对排除，净额 0）', but a reversed original posting still has reverses_posting NULL (the reversal row carries the FK pointing back), so the original is included while its reversal is excluded -> the fully reversed fact contributes the original amount instead of 0; the next bullet still says pool amount is the signed total '含负值冲销', directly contradicting the exclusion. Fix the rule explicitly: either include both original and its negative reversal (signed, pair nets 0) or exclude originals that are the target of a reversal AND the reversal rows (e.g. posting.reverses_posting IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(reversal where reversal.reverses_posting_id = posting.id), plus exclude rows with reverses_posting IS NOT NULL), and align the '签名合计（含负值冲销）' wording.

BLOCKER - PH-252's 22-file whitelist is not the actual dependency-guard failure set: `core.plugin_runtime.set_enabled` blocks disabling X when an enabled plugin requires X, so with invoicing default-enabled requiring {contracts, settlement} only the tests that disable contracts/settlement fail. That set is 16 files (acceptance_revenue, service_period_revenue_http, clearance_http, settlement_http, bank_charge_pairing[_http], billable_reversal[_http], contract_change[_http], contract_change_impact[_http], contract_terms_snapshot[_http], contract_approval, test_v1_contracts). The PR list contains 14 of them but also adds 8 files that only disable costing/cash/onboarding/management_revenue (api_security, bank_charge, bank_charge_approval, bank_charge_approval_http, bank_charge_http, cash_http, revenue_pairing_read, revenue_pairing_read_http) which invoicing does not require and which therefore will not fail; it misses tests/test_contract_approval.py and tests/test_v1_contracts.py, whose PG-only concurrency tests (@skipUnless postgresql, lines 446/316/343) call set_enabled(...,'contracts',False) - skipped locally (explains the local 22) but will fail in PostgreSQL CI and PH-252 cannot fix them (path_out_of_scope). Fix: add the 2 missing paths and either remove the 8 unnecessary ones or document a concrete reason; ideally generate the list from a static dependency-graph script plus PG run.
